Unseen Threat
Innate: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat whenever the enemy loses sight of him causing his next basic attack against an enemy Champion to deal bonus magic damage and slow. Unseen Threat: Kha'Zix's next basic attack against an enemy champion deals bonus magic damage and slows them for a short time.
Innate: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat whenever the enemy loses sight of him or he activates Void Assault. Unseen Threat: Kha'Zix empowers his next basic attack against an enemy champion to deal 22 – 141 (based on level) (+ 50% bonus AD) bonus magic damage and slow them by 25% for 2 seconds.

Any form of vision loss may trigger Unseen Threat, such as Curse of the Black Mist, nearsight and Brushmaker.
Void Assault grants Unseen Threat even if Kha'Zix never becomes unseen (e.g. affected by true sight).
Other stealth such as Senna's Curse of the Black Mist does not do this.
Both the attack's damage and bonus spell damage are grouped under the same cast instance.
Because of this, a single Unseen Threat attack does not trigger two Electrocute stacks.

Isolation effects are registered at the following timings for each ability:
For Evolved Reaper Claws, the start of cast.
For Evolved Spike Racks, when the enemy is hit.
For Taste Their Fear, the end of cast.(bug) This means that if the target is no longer Isolated when the ability hits them, Taste Their Fear will not apply the respective bonuses.
Isolated targets are marked by an indicator, shown to Kha'Zix, when visible and within 2500 units of him. This indicator is independent of the actual effects and its timing may not be fully accurate.
If the target becomes untargetable, dies, or is too far away or no longer in sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

Passive: Each rank in Void Assault allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, granting it additional effects. Active: Kha'Zix gains Unseen Threat and becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed for a brief time. Upon breaking invisibility, Void Assault can be cast a second time at no additional cost.
Passive: Each rank in Void Assault allows Kha'Zix to evolve one of his abilities, granting it additional effects. Evolving an ability causes him to enter a 2-second cast time.Kha'Zix cannot evolve while he is affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control or a lockout that disables abilities.
Active: Kha'Zix becomes invisible for 1.25 seconds, during which he gains 40% bonus movement speed.
After 2 seconds of leaving invisibility, and for the next 12 seconds, Void Assault can be recast at no additional cost.
Recast: Kha'Zix mimics the first cast's effects.

Evolved Bonus: The invisibility is extended, and Void Assault can be cast up to 3 times.
